data.name: Aakash
data.gender_notes: Aakash is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit ākāśa, 'sky, ether, space', from the root kāś, 'to shine'. Its root is Sanskrit ākāśa (आकाश). A classical Sanskrit term for the sky/ether. Aakash is a Sanskrit name meaning “Sky; ether; space”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aakash expresses “Sky; ether; space”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit ākāśa, 'sky, ether, space', from the root kāś, 'to shine'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aakash total 14, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
